title: First installable version
notes: 29 Bibles to read and compare side by side: English (KJV, BSB, WEB, LSV, ASV, YLT, Geneva, Douay-Rheims and more), Messianic and Jewish, the Hebrew Old Testament, four Greek New Testaments, Russian Synodal, Church Slavonic, Makarius and Shona.
Word links between the two columns, and word details with the Hebrew or Greek, grammar and meaning.
Footnotes from the KJV, BSB and WEB; highlights that follow the verse into every version; search by words, reference or Strong's number.
Copyrighted versions (NASB, NKJV, ESV, NIV and others, modern Russian and Xitsonga Bibles) open the same chapter on Bible.com.
Installable on phones and computers, with offline reading.

title: Words of Jesus in red
notes: The words of Jesus are shown in red in every version.
The installed app now downloads only the Bible files that changed in an update.

title: Quotation marks, headings and psalm titles
notes: Quotation marks added where a version prints none (KJV, ASV, Darby, Webster, UKJV, Geneva, Douay-Rheims, Tyndale, BBE, Brenton, Synodal, Church Slavonic, Makarius); Russian uses «…» and „…“.
Words of Jesus: the red runs exactly from his opening to his closing quotation mark, so the narrator stays black.
Section headings and paragraphs in every version, with links to parallel passages; Russian headings for the Russian and Slavonic texts.
Psalm titles are set apart from verse 1.
Each version keeps its own chapter and verse numbers; Compare lines them up verse by verse.

title: Uses in the original language
notes: Uses lists every verse where a Hebrew or Greek word appears, in the original text with the word marked and your version underneath.
It also shows the word's forms with counts and how the KJV translates it.

title: Strong's, BDB and Liddell
notes: New dictionaries under Full entry: Strong's (Hebrew and Greek), the full Brown–Driver–Briggs and Liddell & Scott's Intermediate Greek–English Lexicon.
Verse references in BDB can be tapped to go to that verse.
Open ⤢ shows a long entry in a large window.

title: Home screen and themes
notes: A home screen with Continue reading, Saved verses and Settings.
Themes: Auto, Light, Sepia and Dark.
Choose a Bible language and a default version to open in.

title: Install help
notes: An Install the app card with step-by-step instructions for Android, iPhone and links opened inside other apps.

title: Install help for HarmonyOS
notes: Instructions for adding Lectio to the home screen on HarmonyOS (Huawei Browser).

title: Meanings in word details, and this changelog
notes: Word details list a word's meanings, numbered, and ▸ marks the meaning the dictionary gives for the verse you're reading.
Settings › What's new shows every update. In the installed app you can switch back to an earlier version if an update causes problems.

title: Clearer meaning names
notes: Word details: Greek meanings are named by their definition instead of a sub-heading (πληρόω: “1. to fill, make full” rather than “1. of things”); about 150 words corrected.
